units.chars: 每 100 萬字元（朗讀的輸入文字）

note: 企業代付工具的建議價。prices.<工具>.<計價單位>：price＝沒有對到模型時用的價，models＝各模型自己的價（模型代號跟 Agent 送出的一樣；FAL 是端點路徑），min_sec＝廠商每次最少算幾秒。每一筆都有官方來源（src）與核對日期（as_of）；查不到官方價的模型不列（Portal 照 IT 填的價或每次估價算）。

chars.note: Official $15.00 / 1M chars (tts-1), $30.00 / 1M chars (tts-1-hd). gpt-4o-mini-tts is token-priced only: text input $0.60 / 1M tokens, audio output $12.00 / 1M tokens; no official per-char figure and no official estimated cost per minute shown on the pricing page or model page, so default price omitted.

audio_min.note: OpenAI's published per-minute figures (row labelled 'Whisper' $0.006 / minute, mapped to whisper-1; gpt-4o-transcribe and gpt-4o-mini-transcribe show estimated per-minute figures next to token prices: $2.50 in / $10.00 out and $1.25 / $5.00 per 1M tokens).

minute.note: Official 'GPT-Live sessions' row: gpt-live-1 $0.05 per minute of session duration, billed per second without rounding up to a whole minute. Per the GPT-Live guide (developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/live), backend model and tool usage is billed separately (not included). For reference, gpt-realtime is token-priced (audio $32 in / $64 out per 1M; text $4 / $16) and gpt-realtime-mini (audio $10 / $20); no official per-minute basis for those.

chars.note: Official usage-based API price per 1K chars x1000: v2 Multilingual $0.08/1K, Flash/Turbo $0.04/1K (one shared row), v3 $0.08/1K (v3 Conversational $0.04/1K). Same rate across all plan tiers. Page also lists new v4 ($0.08/1K, promo $0.022 until Oct 12) and v4 Turbo ($0.04/1K, promo $0.011).

audio_min.note: Official Scribe v2 $0.22 per hour / 60. Scribe v2 Realtime is $0.39/hr; add-ons entity detection $0.070/hr, keyterm prompting $0.050/hr.
Official $0.04/hr (turbo) and $0.111/hr (large-v3), divided by 60. Minimum billed length 10 seconds per request. groq.com/pricing did not render prices (JS page); figures from Groq's official docs.

Voxtral Mini Transcribe 2 audio input $0.003/min (Mistral docs: voxtral-mini-latest on the transcriptions endpoint = Voxtral Mini Transcribe 2, voxtral-mini-2602). Voxtral Small audio input $0.004/min (text input $0.1, output $0.4 per 1M tokens extra). Voxtral Mini Transcribe Realtime is $0.006/min.

chars.note: Official 'Voxtral TTS $0.016 per 1k characters' x1000 (docs.mistral.ai/inference/pricing shows the same as $16 / M chars output). Mapped Voxtral TTS (v26.03) to voxtral-mini-tts-2603.

tok_in.note: Paid tier, text input per 1M tokens. Page also lists gemini-3.8-flash-tts ($0.50), gemini-3.8-flash-lite-tts ($0.50), gemini-3.1-flash-tts-preview ($1.00).

tok_out.note: Paid tier, audio output per 1M tokens. Page also lists gemini-3.8-flash-tts ($9.00), gemini-3.8-flash-lite-tts ($6.00, both through 2026-12-31), gemini-3.1-flash-tts-preview ($20.00).

chars.note: Official 'Text to Speech | $15.00 / 1M chars'; no model name given.

audio_min.note: Official 'Speech to Text $0.10 / hr (REST)' / 60; streaming is $0.20/hr ($0.0033333/min). No model name given.

image.src: https://fal.ai/models/<model id> (each model's official fal.ai page)
image.note: Assumes one 1-megapixel (1024x1024) image. Per-MP models: klein 9b $0.006/MP (rounding not stated), z-image turbo $0.005/MP (+$0.0025 optional prompt expansion), qwen-image $0.02/MP, flux-2-pro $0.03 first MP + $0.015 per extra MP of input/output (rounded up). nano-banana-pro $0.15 standard (4K = 2x, web search +$0.015). nano-banana-2 $0.08 at 1K (0.5K 0.75x, 2K 1.5x, 4K 2x). gpt-image-1.5 at endpoint defaults quality=high, 1024x1024 ($0.133; medium $0.034, low $0.009) plus $0.005/1K input text tokens. ideogram v3 TURBO $0.03 (page summary said TURBO is default; BALANCED $0.06, QUALITY $0.09). recraft v4 pro and kling-image v3 are flat per image.

video_sec.note: Lowest listed resolution, audio off, unless noted. pixverse v6: 360p $0.025 (audio $0.035; 720p $0.045/$0.060; 1080p $0.090/$0.115); default resolution not stated. veo3.1: 720p/1080p $0.20 no audio, $0.40 with audio (4K $0.40/$0.60; Fast tier $0.10/$0.15). kling v3 standard $0.084 off / $0.126 audio / $0.154 voice control; pro $0.112 / $0.168 / $0.196. seedance 2.0: page quotes default 720p with audio $0.3034/s (token-priced $0.014 per 1K tokens, tokens = h*w*duration*24/1024; 480p would be about $0.13/s, computed). ltx-2.3-22b: official $0.001605 per MP of width*height*frames (audio included); converted assuming 1280x720 at 24 fps = 22.1 MP/s, about $0.0355/s (page example: 121 frames 720p = $0.179). minimax h3: 480p $0.05 (768p $0.06, 2K $0.13, 4K $0.16). Image-to-video variants not checked.

image.note: API is USD-denominated per image (not compute units). Text-to-image at 1K; with style references +$0.005, with moodboards +$0.010 (medium $0.035/$0.040, large $0.065/$0.070, per krea.ai/docs/developers/krea-2/overview). The docs page does not list a turbo endpoint; turbo $0.015 comes from the API pricing page only.

call.note: Search API $5.00 per 1,000 successful requests, no token costs, same price however many queries are in one request. A 'Fast Search API' tier is $1.00 per 1,000.
